lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs extending from posterior of the pectoral fin toward the caudal region, forming a semi-regular grid pattern with approximately 4-5 visible horizontal tiers.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with horizontal tiers of blobs; blobs serve as nodal points at these intersections, particularly prominent in the mid-lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary longitudinal ridge is visible running along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-luminance dorsal pixels to shadowed ventral pixels.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 6-8 distinct high-luminance blobs are visible on the first dorsal fin, distributed irregularly with a visible concentration toward the anterior base of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Transition to high-density, reduced-diameter micro-spotting on the cephalic region anterior to the gill slits.
